description: Runtime contract fixtures for the agnthive hook dispatcher (plan task 02; design F01-F10, ADR 0010-0013). One manifest entry per scenario; entries may share a payload when only the expected output class differs (the two PermissionDenied entries share one stdin).
cli_version_basis: Locally tested baseline was CLI 2.1.292 (design 'Oblique and validation limits'); 2.1.303 is the plan/design candidate from the observed upstream changelog, NOT a version certified on this machine. Task 01 pins the verified version and task 14 re-runs the canaries; when that happens, update cli_version_target per entry and flip source to captured.

status_model.active: The contract test spawns the dispatcher with this payload today and asserts the event-specific output class in the expected_class vocabulary.
status_model.pending_capture: The payload is a placeholder of the documented input shape only; the runtime contract for this scenario is NOT pinned. The contract test validates the manifest entry and payload shape but skips dispatcher execution. A manual canary on the target CLI (a live, instrumented Claude Code session capturing hook stdin to a file) must replace the placeholder and set source=captured + status=active.
status_model.captured: Reserved value: payload was observed on the target CLI. No entry currently uses it; flipping a synthetic payload to captured without replacing it with a real capture is forbidden (plan 02.1).

entries.description: Normal user prompt (not a slash command, not a background return). Documented session/prompt envelope; classified as a feature workflow.
entries.active_reason: Input and output shapes are fully documented (session/prompt envelope; additionalContext envelope); no host capture is needed to pin the envelope class.

entries.description: Return of a background subagent, which the host surfaces as UserPromptSubmit. Must not reclassify as a new user task or erase sibling state (F02, ADR 0010). The prompt body for a background return is the unknown to capture.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: start a session, launch a background subagent, let it return, and dump the UserPromptSubmit stdin JSON; redact prompt body.

entries.description: Namespaced slash command input (/agnthive:manager ...) as the user typed it, which arrives before expansion (F06). Namespace/command/args normalization is plan task 05.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: type a namespaced plugin command in a live session and dump the UserPromptSubmit stdin JSON (pre-expansion, prompt_id included); redact nothing but keep the session id synthetic.

entries.description: Degenerate harness input: empty stdin for a telemetry event. Notification is used as the hermetic carrier event; the parse warning is event-independent.
entries.active_reason: Degenerate harness input (zero-byte stdin); the parse-invariant is event-independent and fully testable without a capture.

entries.description: Degenerate harness input: truncated JSON on stdin for a telemetry event. Parse failure is reported to stderr, the hook still exits 0 with {} (never blocks).
entries.active_reason: Degenerate harness input (truncated JSON); the parse-invariant is event-independent and fully testable without a capture.

entries.description: Foreground Bash command PostToolUse. Output envelope is stable, but COMPLETION SEMANTICS are not pinned: the runtime must distinguish pending/completed/failed/unknown from tool_response (F01, task 04) and the real tool_response shape is unobserved.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: run a real foreground test command in a live session and dump the PostToolUse(Bash) stdin JSON including tool_response; redact command output.

entries.description: Backgrounded Bash command PostToolUse. Must not be counted as completed verification (F01: a background launch is pending, not passed); the real tool_response/background task shape is unobserved.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: run a real backgrounded test command (run_in_background: true) and dump the PostToolUse(Bash) stdin JSON including the background task response; redact command output.

entries.description: Return of a background subagent via SubagentStop: parent vs agent transcript paths and closing text vs SubagentHandback delivered report are distinct data (ADR 0010). Currently a read-only placeholder.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: let a real specialist subagent finish and dump the SubagentStop stdin JSON (both transcript paths, agent id, closing text); redact all message content.

entries.description: Stop while verification/review is still outstanding (active work). The real payload carries background-task/session info the runtime should consume instead of transcript heuristics (F08).
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: let a real session re-enter Stop with outstanding verification and dump the Stop stdin JSON (including any background task fields); redact message text.

entries.description: Stop re-invoked after our own block (stop_hook_active=true) with completed work: must yield without re-blocking (ADR 0003), and a second Stop on finished work must stay clean.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: trigger our own Stop block once, then capture the runtime's re-invocation (stop_hook_active=true) and the next clean Stop stdin JSON; redact message content.

entries.description: SessionStart with source=compact after a real compaction. Ledger restoration channel per ADR 0013; event order and delivery are the capture targets (F07).
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: compact a live session (manual and automatic) and dump the SessionStart(stdin) JSON; verify the source field value and record event order around PostCompact.

entries.description: SessionStart with source=resume after a real session resume. Duplicate ledger restoration must not happen across the paired lifecycle events (ADR 0013).
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: resume a previous live session (claude --resume) and dump the SessionStart stdin JSON; verify the source field value.

entries.description: PostCompact after a real compaction: bounded bookkeeping only (ADR 0013); async stdout JSON is not proven delivery to the model (F07), and compact_summary content must be redacted at capture.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: capture PostCompact stdin right after a real compaction; redact or truncate compact_summary before storing.

entries.description: Repeated SubagentStart for an already-known agent id (resume): lifecycle must update in place, not count a second specialist instance (F08, ADR 0010). The resume marker field is the unknown to capture.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: resume the same subagent twice in a live session and dump both SubagentStart stdin JSON payloads; compare the identity fields.

entries.description: Pins the CURRENT documented PermissionDenied class: {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PermissionDenied', retry}} for a non-hard-denied command (retry stays the command-retry invitation, not permission approval). Updated during task 02: the review-baseline legacy top-level {retry} shorthand (F05) was detected and task 03 has since landed the documented envelope; a silent regression back to bare {retry} now fails this manifest's exact-allowed-fields check.
entries.known_gap: Input-side shape is still synthetic: the exact PermissionDenied stdin field set is a capture target (see compat_permission_denied_capture). The F05 baseline emitted bare {retry:true}; detection of that legacy form is now the exact-allowed-fields check on this entry.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: confirm the exact PermissionDenied stdin field set on 2.1.303 and keep the payload in sync.
entries.active_reason: The output envelope is documented (and task 03 has landed it); the exact-field assertion does not depend on the unobserved input field set. Input-side capture is a separate entry.

entries.description: Input-shape capture target for PermissionDenied on the pinned CLI; shares the payload with compat_permission_denied_current_envelope. The OUTPUT class is asserted by the envelope entry above; only the input side stays unconfirmed.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: capture one real PermissionDenied event on 2.1.303 (hard-denied command and retriable command), replace the shared payload, then flip source=captured and status=active.
